subject: Y1
name: Trumbull — golden masonry and cool Gothic recesses

styleSelection.reason: The reference is carried by luminous golden wall planes, connected cool cast shadows, and precise Gothic openings; fine structural lines supplement transparent paint.

families.referenceCue: Pale blue sky and soft cloud whites between irregular roof silhouettes: connected flowing pale wash starting on dry paper, own wet overlap allowed, with cloud lights reserved and firm roof boundaries. The confined sky shapes must not be pre-wetted into a pooled wet footprint.

Sunlit ochre gable, four narrow upper lancets, paired large Gothic arches and lower doorways; connected pale stone wash, dry middle planes, then shadow glaze across masonry and recesses. Preserve light arch rims and the narrow left arris.

Left wing and side wall are cooler and darker than the front gable. Broad stone wash, fully dry mid planes, a connected blue and raw-sienna shadow across wall, window bays and base; avoid isolated stone flecks.
Tall cropped chimney has a warm narrow right face and cool left face. Keep vertical arrises and cap ledges; wash each value plane broadly and carry the shadow through the courses.
Receding right wing: warm wall and cool roof, quiet rectangular window groups. Use dry-edged connected planes and subordinate window detail to the central arches.
Second chimney has a dark slotted crown, broad golden shaft and cool side edge. Preserve its silhouette and model the shaft before adding the crown accents.
Lower right projecting building: pale sloping roof and golden wall, narrow cool windows and a cast eave shadow. Keep roof glints, use one dry shadow through eave and openings.

Yellow-green foreground crown is an irregular connected mass, with light holes and darker olive groups toward its base. Pale flowing wash first; dry and add connected shadow groups, then only a few focal leaf edges.
Lower-left foliage is a subdued olive mass against the wall, not individually outlined leaves; dry shadow groups link it to the ground.
A narrow pale pavement strip, cool cast shadows and tiny figures establish scale. Wash the ground lightly; retain bright shirts and use a few late dark accents, without outlining every figure.
